WITH country_attendance AS (
  SELECT 
    p.birth_country,
    COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM player_college pc
  INNER JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_country,
    tally,
    SUM(tally) OVER () as total_tally,
    AVG(tally) OVER () as avg_tally,
    CAST(tally AS NUMERIC) / SUM(tally) OVER () as share
  FROM country_attendance
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    tally,
    share,
    avg_tally
  FROM with_stats
  WHERE tally > avg_tally
)
SELECT 
  SUM(tally) as combined_tally,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(tally - avg_tally) as average_above_average
FROM above_average
